**Coaching Note:**

White's queen on c3 was attacked twice (by your queen and rook) but defended only once. More importantly, White's c2 pawn was pinned to the king by your rook. When White's queen moved to c3, it lost the protection of that pawn. Your queen could capture it with check, forcing the king to recapture, and then your rook delivers another check—attacking both the king and the undefended rook. You win a full rook and pawn. Always scan for pieces attacked twice with only one defender, especially when pins are present.
